info.title: F-Grade Zoho CRM API
info.description: Read-only Zoho CRM API for Microsoft Copilot Studio.  CRITICAL DATA ACCURACY RULES: 1. ALWAYS call the appropriate CRM tool before answering any CRM question involving a record count, date, user, module, or business metric. Never answer from model knowledge. 2. Treat the tool response as the sole source of truth. 3. When the user mentions a month, convert it to an exact half-open date range: June 2026 → from=2026-06-01, to=2026-07-01. July 2026 → from=2026-07-01, to=2026-08-01. 4. The from date is inclusive (>=) and the to date is exclusive (<). 5. For "leads created in June": module=Leads, date_field=Created_Time, from=2026-06-01, to=2026-07-01. 6. For "leads modified in June": date_field=Modified_Time. 7. For "deals closed in June": date_field=Closing_Date. 8. If the tool returns zero records, say only: "No matching CRM records were found for the requested criteria." Do not add explanations about what dates the CRM contains. 9. If the tool call fails, say: "I couldn't retrieve the CRM data because the CRM request failed." Never convert a failure into 0 records. 10. Never add unsupported statements about what date ranges exist in the CRM unless the tool explicitly returned that evidence. 11. Do not ask the user for technical parameters (page, per_page, fields, from, to, filter) when they can be inferred from the request. 12. After the tool returns records, present them directly. Do not replace them with generic statements.

get.description: ALWAYS call this tool for count/how-many questions before answering. Use when the user asks: how many, count, total, number of records, or any filtered count. Do NOT use this tool for activity reports; use getCRMActivityReport instead. MONTH CONVERSION (required): "leads created in June" → from=2026-06-01, to=2026-07-01. The from is inclusive, to is exclusive. Infer the date field from context: "created in June" → date_field=Created_Time. "modified in June" → date_field=Modified_Time. "closed in June" → date_field=Closing_Date. Return the exact count the tool provides. Do not invent or estimate a count. Zero result: say "No matching CRM records were found for the requested criteria." Tool failure: say "I couldn't retrieve the CRM data because the CRM request failed."

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Canonical or natural-language module name. Examples: Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals. Do NOT pass "Activities" here.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Use count for count questions such as "how many leads were created in July".

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: Optional Zoho CRM criteria string for filtered counts, such as (Company:equals:ABC).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional Zoho CRM criteria string for filtered counts. Use criteria when possible.

parameters.name: date_field
parameters.description: Optional CRM date field API name to filter count by, such as Created_Time or Modified_Time.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the date range (>=). Convert month names to the 1st of the month: June 2026 → 2026-06-01. July 2026 → 2026-07-01. August 2026 → 2026-08-01.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive end of the date range (<). Convert month names to the 1st of the following month: June 2026 → 2026-07-01. July 2026 → 2026-08-01. August 2026 → 2026-09-01.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional original user wording for diagnostics only. Do not rely on this instead of structured filters and dates.

parameters.name: retrieval_mode
parameters.description: Use count for count requests.

401.description: Authentication required or invalid OAuth token

500.description: Server error or Zoho API error

get.description: ALWAYS call this tool for any list/view/show/retrieve/find request before answering. Never default to retrieving the complete module. CRITICAL ROUTING RULE: Do NOT use this tool for "today's activity" or employee action reports. Never pass module="Activities". For "Give me today's activity" or "What did Sanjay do today?", use getCRMActivityReport (/api/crm/activity) instead. MONTH CONVERSION (required): "leads created in June" → from=2026-06-01, to=2026-07-01. "July leads" → from=2026-07-01, to=2026-08-01. The from is inclusive (>=), the to is exclusive (<). Infer the date field: "created" → date_field=Created_Time. "modified" → date_field=Modified_Time. "closed" → date_field=Closing_Date. Pass the user-requested limit directly: "give me 10 leads" → limit=10. Do not ask the user for technical parameters. After the tool returns, present the returned records directly. Do not substitute them with a generic statement. Zero result: say "No matching CRM records were found for the requested criteria." Tool failure: say "I couldn't retrieve the CRM data because the CRM request failed." Never claim all records are from a specific date unless the tool explicitly returned evidence for that. For list requests, use retrieval_mode=limited (explicit count) or retrieval_mode=filtered (date/filter). Never use all in normal Copilot conversations.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Canonical or natural-language module name. Examples: Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals. Do NOT pass "Activities" here; use getCRMActivityReport for activity reports.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Use query for record lists. Use count only when the user asks how many or total records; count returns no records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Requested number of records to return. For "first 10" or "10 leads", pass 10. If omitted for a normal list, the backend uses a safe bounded default.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional page number for paginated requests.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Optional records per page for paginated requests.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated field API names to include in each record.

parameters.name: date_field
parameters.description: Optional CRM date field API name to filter by, such as Created_Time or Modified_Time.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the date range (>=). Convert month names to the 1st of the month: June 2026 → 2026-06-01. July 2026 → 2026-07-01. August 2026 → 2026-08-01.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive end of the date range (<). Convert month names to the 1st of the following month: June 2026 → 2026-07-01. July 2026 → 2026-08-01. August 2026 → 2026-09-01.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional Zoho CRM criteria string for server-side filtering. Use criteria when possible.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: Optional Zoho CRM criteria string for server-side filtering, such as (Company:equals:ABC).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional original user wording for diagnostics only. Always pass structured limit, criteria, date range, operation, and retrieval_mode when known.

parameters.name: retrieval_mode
parameters.description: Use limited for explicit record counts, filtered for date/filter queries, page for explicit pagination, and count for count requests. Do not use all for normal Copilot conversations.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of CRM record ids to fetch.

get.summary: Get today's CRM activity and daily audit report
get.description: Use this operation whenever the user asks for "today's CRM activity", "What did Sanjay do today?", "Show me today's activity for all employees", or daily changes. Retrieves activity from Zoho Audit Log, Tasks, Meetings, Calls, and Notes. Never use queryCRMRecords with module="Activities" for this purpose. Pass user_id for a specific employee or leave empty for all employees. Dates default to today in Asia/Kolkata timezone.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Optional CRM module API name to filter activity by (e.g. Deals, Meetings, Notes).

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Optional Zoho CRM user ID or user name to filter activity by (e.g. Sanjay).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Optional start ISO datetime or YYYY-MM-DD string. Defaults to today 00:00:00+05:30.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Optional end ISO datetime or YYYY-MM-DD string. Defaults to tomorrow 00:00:00+05:30.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Optional action filter such as created, updated, or added.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of activity objects to return. Default is 100.

401.description: Authentication required or invalid OAuth token

500.description: Server error or Zoho API error
